Hello,

I would like to kindly request an illustration of a tiger character.
I am happy to leave most of the artistic decisions up to your creativity and style.

If possible, I would greatly appreciate it if the following elements could be included:
・A kimono or samurai-inspired outfit
・A warm, gentle smile

Thank you very much for considering my request.
I look forward to your wonderful artwork.
